jordan: Quick async check-in — what I did / blockers / today
jordan: Did: tightened JWT parsing in gateway, ran a short replay of rotate-tokens scenario against staging, rolled out fallback routing for 2 routes.
jordan: Blocker: intermittent 401s during rotation window ~1.8% — unsure if it's token issuance or our cache invalidation.
jordan: Today: follow up with auth-team, add a gauge for token-propagation-ms, and open PR to make routing rollouts safer.

maya: Saw the same 401s in logs, forwarding a few spans to this thread. Sending DM with span ids.
maya: Did: adjusted token-cache TTL from 30s->15s on staging to reduce staleness, added a smoke test that exercises rotation flow.
maya: Blocker: waiting on review for PR #4219 (routing: safe-fallback ordering).

sam: Re: #4219 — left comments about preserving x-forwarded-user header and ensuring header passthrough on fallback.
sam: Also lowered burst limit on internal lanes from 60->25 in staging and started a percentile histogram for burst events.
sam: Today: will draft the runbook snippet for canary checks and open INFRA ticket for prod edge permission (INFRA-227).

lee: On it, grabbing the PR for review. Can someone paste one trace id here so I can pull the span?
lee: Pushed a tiny validation that rejects tokens with nbf in the future — should cut down on some test-token noise.

anika: Noticed tail latency blip at 14:12 correlating with a routing rule change (r-217). Added dashboard alert rule: routing.rule_change_rate > 3/min -> alert on-call with runbook link.

ops-bot: deploy: gw-service v3.12.5 deployed to staging by @lee
ops-bot: smokecheck: auth rotation smoke passed (6/6), rate limiter smoke partial fail (4/6) -> ticket #549 created

jordan: Trace ids DM'd: span-9c4d2a. I also pushed a small quantile comparison script to compare pre/post canary buckets, assigned to @sam.

lee: If PR looks good I'll canary at 10% for 20m, monitor 95th latency, 401 rate, burst histogram, and token-propagation-ms.
lee: Please add a concise canary checklist to the runbook; left a TODO in the PR description.

sam: I'll add runbook steps + PromQL for the burst histogram and token-propagation metric.
sam: Blocking: need INFRA permission to flip edge config in prod; INFRA-227 opened and assigned to infra-oncall.

jordan: Plan: aim for canary at 11:30 PT if infra approves and @lee gives final sign-off. I'll announce the flip in this thread when I start. :thumbsup:
maya: :thumbsup:
lee: :eyes:
anika: watching alert channel and will escalate if rule-change alert fires
